source: NVIDIA GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local config and index at f5a0baba30120da613e27973ee3535a725d4ece3. Names and config values are public. Header dtypes, shapes and offsets are synthetic.
scope: Curated loader comparison. This is not an automatic operation detector or a complete checkpoint inventory. No weights or shard headers were read. No inference support is claimed.

operations.name: Mixed storage schema
operations.evidence: quantization_config.exclude_modules; MXFP8 weight_block_size; NVFP4 weight_scale_encoding=csf_32x2_v1; FP8_PB_WO
operations.gap: flash/mixed.rs accepts exclude_modules without ignore and an absent or null kv_cache_quant_algo. It accepts MXFP8 weight_block_size [1,32] and FP8_PB_WO metadata. It accepts csf, not csf_32x2_v1. plan/config.rs refuses FP8_PB_WO with MissingOps because its weight_scale execution binding is absent. Recipe acceptance does not validate tensor layouts.

operations.name: KDA recurrence and gates
operations.gap: The current linear mixer is Gated DeltaNet. Its fused qkv input and scalar head decay do not implement KDA. See flash/refcpu.rs and gpu/kernels/src/flash_gdn.rs.

operations.name: Latent attention
operations.gap: The serving path lacks an MLA low-rank projection binding and latent cache. plan/tensors.rs expects direct q_proj/k_proj/v_proj. The standalone mla.rs host reference does not enable serving.

operations.name: Sparse attention indexer
operations.gap: The serving QSA path has no DSA indexer binding for these compressed-pool tensors. Standalone plan/dsa.rs metadata and dsa.rs host checks do not enable serving. See plan/tensors.rs.

operations.name: Manifold-constrained hyper-connections
operations.gap: The current low-rank sigmoid hyper-connection path lacks the mHC Sinkhorn operation and these tensors. See flash/refcpu.rs and plan/tensors.rs.

operations.name: Sigmoid expert routing
operations.gap: The current router uses full softmax followed by top-k. It lacks this corrected sigmoid selection and routed scaling. See gpu/kernels/src/moe.rs.

operations.name: Capped SwiGLU
operations.gap: The current SwiGLU has no configured cap. See flash/nvfp4.rs swiglu_ref.

operations.name: Dense and expert layer schedule
operations.gap: Dense and expert FFN primitives exist. plan/config.rs assigns a single FFN shape to all decoder layers. It does not read this per-layer schedule.

operations.name: MTP plan and tensor names
operations.gap: MTP exists. The planner reads mtp_num_hidden_layers and mtp.fc/pre_fc_norm names. It does not read this MTP schema or the appended decoder-layer names. See plan/config.rs and plan/tensors.rs.

operations.name: Vision and video
operations.gap: The serving API rejects image input. The Flash path does not execute this GLM vision tower or merger. The fixture records the config declaration only. See serve/src/protocol.rs and model/src/flash/mod.rs.
